zh-Hans.tag: 领克 OS N · Android 9 适配版
zh-Hans.title:
让熟悉的 CarPlay，
来到你的领克。
zh-Hans.intro: 为领克 OS N 2.0 / Android 9 车机适配的开源 CarPlay 接收端。连接 iPhone，在车机上使用地图、音乐与通话。
zh-Hans.scope: 基于 DiPlay 的独立社区适配项目。不是领克或 Apple 官方产品。
zh-Hans.connectionTitle: 有线可用 · 无线调试中
zh-Hans.wiredNotice: 有线连接请使用支持数据传输的数据线，将 iPhone 接到车机 USB-A 口。不要连接车上的 USB-C（C 口），该接口仅用于充电。
zh-Hans.wirelessNotice: 无线连接目前仍在调试，不能正常使用，正在继续测试与修复。请先使用有线连接。
zh-Hans.riskTitle: 风险提示 · 安装与使用前必读
zh-Hans.riskSummary: 本项目仅为实验项目，下载安装需谨慎。存在车机损坏、系统异常、数据丢失、断连、黑屏或音频故障等风险，可能影响导航与通话。仅在车辆停稳后安装、设置和排查故障，行驶中请勿操作。
zh-Hans.downloadConsent: 下载、安装或使用本项目，即表示您已阅读、理解并同意本页免责声明；如不同意，请勿下载、安装或使用。
zh-Hans.disclaimerLink: 查看免责声明与完整风险
zh-Hans.disclaimerIntro: 本项目仅为实验项目，是基于 DiPlay 修改的独立开源社区项目，并非领克、吉利或 Apple 官方产品，未获得这些品牌的认证、授权或背书。下载安装需谨慎，请在了解以下风险后自主决定是否安装和使用。

risks.title: 驾驶安全
risks.text: 安装、配对、设置、测试和故障排查均应在车辆安全停稳后进行。行驶中不要操作或处理异常，始终以道路情况和原车安全功能为准。

risks.title: 连接、画面与音频
risks.text: 可能出现断连、卡顿、黑屏、声音丢失或切换异常，影响导航、音乐与通话。发生异常时请安全停车后退出本应用并恢复使用原车功能；不要将本项目作为唯一的导航或紧急通话途径。

risks.title: 兼容性与持续可用性
risks.text: 当前仅针对目标车型进行有限验证，不能保证其他车型、固件或 iOS 版本可用。系统升级、USB/蓝牙限制、第三方协议或实验认证变化均可能导致功能失效。无线目前不能正常使用，仍在测试与修复中。

risks.title: 安装来源、数据与车机政策
risks.text: 完整 APK 暂不公开，请勿信任外部来源声称提供的本项目安装包。第三方应用存在设备与个人数据风险；不要为安装而关闭系统安全保护或强行刷机。安装、更新前备份重要设置；卸载会删除应用内数据。车机安装限制及相关售后政策请向厂商确认。

risks.title: 权限与诊断隐私
risks.text: 麦克风、蓝牙、网络等权限请按实际功能需要授权。诊断报告会包含设备与连接信息，自动脱敏不能保证识别全部敏感内容。GitHub 问题反馈是公开的，分享前请检查并删除个人信息、网络标识及其他敏感资料。

risks.title: 实验认证与第三方权利
risks.text: 实验认证素材并非 Apple 为本项目签发的官方认证，持续可用性和一般分发条件尚未确定。公开源码不包含这些认证输入，自行编译源码不代表具备完整 CarPlay 连接能力。代码许可证不授予第三方商标、图标或认证素材的使用权；请遵守相应许可与要求。

zh-Hans.disclaimerTerms: 本软件按“现状”提供，不保证兼容性、稳定性、特定用途或持续可用。因下载、安装、使用或无法使用本项目导致的车机损坏、系统异常、数据丢失、导航或通话中断及其他损失，在适用法律允许的范围内，作者及贡献者不承担责任。依法不得排除或限制的责任不受本声明影响，包括人身损害及因故意或重大过失造成的财产损失。声明效力以适用法律为准，不影响开源许可证授予的权利。使用时请遵守当地法规及车辆厂商的要求。
zh-Hans.screenshotAlt: 领克适配版实际 App 首页，包含无线连接与 USB 连接两个入口
zh-Hans.caption: 实际 App 界面 · USB 有线连接可用，无线入口仍在调试中
zh-Hans.releaseHint: 官网与源码现已开放。完整安装包暂不公开；后续发布后，这里会提供 APK 下载与更新说明。
steps: 安装包发布后，下载领克适配版 APK，安装在 Android 车机上，不是 iPhone 上。
打开 App，先在设置中运行环境检测，按提示处理 USB 和必要权限。
选择 USB 连接，用支持数据传输的数据线将 iPhone 接到车机 USB-A 口。不要使用车上的 USB-C（C 口），该接口仅用于充电。
无线连接仍在调试、测试与修复中，目前不能正常使用，请先使用有线连接。
zh-Hans.updateHint: 同包名、同签名的新版可覆盖安装，保留配对与设置。App 的“设置 → 支持 → 应用更新”提供检查更新与官网入口。
zh-Hans.guide: 查看完整适配与安装说明
features: 领克风格界面，支持 USB 有线连接；无线入口保留用于后续调试。
Android 9 USB 配置核验、连接资源释放与音频生命周期适配。
只读环境检测，有线与无线诊断汇总为一份文件，由用户主动导出。
自动检查公开版本信息，也可手动检查；下载与安装由用户确认。
zh-Hans.compatibilityText: 目标为 2023 款领克 03，OS N 2.0 / Android 9。用户已确认 test17 有线连接可用、流畅度尚可。有线请连接车机 USB-A 口，车上的 USB-C 口仅用于充电。无线目前不能正常使用，仍在调试、测试与修复中。其他车型、固件与 iOS 版本需独立验证。
zh-Hans.feedbackText: 在设置中导出诊断报告，附上车机型号、系统版本、App 版本与复现步骤。提交前检查并删除个人信息。
zh-Hans.credits: 本项目基于 DiPlay 修改，保留原作者与贡献者署名，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可证。上游项目与第三方许可：
zh-Hans.footer: LynkCo CarPlay · 独立社区项目。车辆停稳后再进行安装与设置。

en.title:
Your familiar CarPlay.
Now in your Lynk.
en.intro: An open-source CarPlay receiver adapted for Lynk OS N 2.0 / Android 9 head units. Connect your iPhone for maps, music and calls on the car screen.
en.scope: An independent community adaptation of DiPlay. Not an official Lynk or Apple product.
en.wiredNotice: For wired connectivity, connect your iPhone to the head unit's USB-A port with a data-capable cable. Do not use the car's USB-C port: it is for charging only.
en.wirelessNotice: Wireless connectivity is still being debugged, tested and repaired. It currently does not work properly. Please use a wired connection for now.
en.riskTitle: Risk notice · Read before installing or using
en.riskSummary: This is an experimental project only. Download and install with caution. Risks include head-unit damage, system failures, data loss, disconnections, a blank screen or audio failures that may affect navigation and calls. Install, configure and troubleshoot only while safely parked. Do not operate it while driving.
en.downloadConsent: By downloading, installing or using this project, you indicate that you have read, understood and agreed to this page's disclaimer. If you disagree, do not download, install or use it.
en.disclaimerLink: Read the disclaimer and full risks
en.disclaimerIntro: This is an experimental project only and an independent open-source community adaptation of DiPlay, not an official Lynk, Geely or Apple product. It is not certified, authorized or endorsed by these brands. Download and install with caution, and decide whether to proceed only after understanding the following risks.

risks.title: Driving safety
risks.text: Install, pair, configure, test and troubleshoot only while safely parked. Do not operate the app or handle failures while driving. Always prioritize road conditions and the vehicle's original safety functions.

risks.title: Connection, video and audio
risks.text: Disconnections, stuttering, a blank screen, missing audio or switching failures may affect navigation, music and calls. If a failure occurs, park safely before exiting the app and returning to the vehicle's original functions. Do not rely on this project as your only navigation or emergency calling method.

risks.title: Compatibility and continued availability
risks.text: Validation is limited to the target vehicle; other cars, firmware and iOS versions are not guaranteed to work. System updates, USB or Bluetooth restrictions, third-party protocols or changes to experimental authentication may break functionality. Wireless currently does not work properly and is still being tested and repaired.

risks.title: Installation sources, data and vehicle policies
risks.text: A complete APK is not publicly distributed. Do not trust external sources claiming to provide this project's installer. Third-party apps can pose risks to devices and personal data. Do not disable system security or force-flash the head unit to install it. Back up important settings before installing or updating; uninstalling removes app-private data. Confirm installation restrictions and service policies with the manufacturer.

risks.title: Permissions and diagnostic privacy
risks.text: Grant microphone, Bluetooth and network permissions only as needed for the features you use. Diagnostic reports include device and connection information; automatic redaction cannot detect every sensitive detail. GitHub issues are public. Review and remove personal information, network identifiers and other sensitive data before sharing.

risks.title: Experimental authentication and third-party rights
risks.text: Experimental authentication material is not official certification issued by Apple for this project. Continued acceptance and suitability for general distribution remain unresolved. The public source excludes these authentication inputs; compiling it does not by itself provide full CarPlay connectivity. Code licenses do not grant rights to third-party trademarks, icons or authentication material. Follow the relevant licenses and requirements.

en.disclaimerTerms: The software is provided as is, without guarantees of compatibility, stability, fitness for a particular purpose or continued availability. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the authors and contributors are not liable for head-unit damage, system failures, data loss, interrupted navigation or calls, or other losses resulting from downloading, installing, using or being unable to use this project. Liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited remains unaffected, including liability for personal injury or property damage caused by intentional conduct or gross negligence where applicable. The effect of this notice is subject to applicable law and does not alter rights granted by the open-source licenses. Follow local laws and the vehicle manufacturer's requirements.
en.screenshotAlt: Actual Lynk edition home screen with wireless and USB connection choices
en.caption: Actual app interface · USB wired connectivity works; wireless is still being debugged
en.releaseHint: The website and source code are available. A complete APK is not publicly distributed yet. Downloads and release notes will appear here after publication.
en.setup: Install on the head unit. Connect your iPhone.
steps: Once available, download the Lynk edition APK and install it on the Android head unit, not your iPhone.
Open Settings and run the environment check. Follow the prompts for USB and required permissions.
Choose the USB connection and connect your iPhone to the head unit's USB-A port with a data-capable cable. Do not use the car's USB-C port: it is for charging only.
Wireless connectivity is still being debugged, tested and repaired and currently does not work properly. Please use a wired connection for now.
en.updateHint: Updates with the same package name and signing key can be installed over the existing app to preserve pairing and settings. Find update checks and the website in Settings → Support → App updates.
features: Lynk-style interface with USB wired connectivity; the wireless entry remains available for further debugging.
Android 9 USB configuration checks, connection cleanup and audio lifecycle adaptations.
Read-only environment checks and one user-exported report for wired and wireless diagnostics.
Automatic and manual public version checks. You choose when to download and install.
en.compatibilityText: Target: 2023 Lynk 03, OS N 2.0 / Android 9. The user confirmed working USB connectivity and acceptable smoothness with test17. Use the head unit's USB-A port for data; the car's USB-C port is for charging only. Wireless currently does not work properly and is still being debugged, tested and repaired. Other cars, firmware and iOS versions require separate testing.
en.feedbackText: Export a diagnostic report in Settings and include the head unit, OS, app version and reproduction steps. Review and remove personal information before posting.
en.credits: Modified from DiPlay, retaining the original author and contributor credits, under AGPL-3.0. Upstream project and third-party licenses:
en.footer: LynkCo CarPlay · Independent community project. Install and configure only while parked.
